title: KORS, Kernel for Operations and Resources System: Specification
description: KORS names an architecture property of production management applications (MES, QMS, CMMS, DMS, PLM and other ISA-95 Level 3 applications). A system is KORS if it satisfies five criteria: event-based communication, a common vocabulary at the boundaries, autonomy of each service, modular adoption and open data. This record archives the specification, its conformance rules and its governance.
